world.title: I Moved Back to India to Be Near Family and Leave H-1B Limits Behind
world.summary: Disha Lamba, 28, relocated from New York to Gurugram, India, after leaving her job at CVS Health. She aimed to be closer to family and escape H-1B visa restrictions. Although she felt she was sacrificing much by leaving the U.S., Lamba, an introvert, sought comfort in her home country, reflecting on her experiences and personal growth.

world.title: PM Modi, Xi, Putin, other world leaders in Bishkek: What's on SCO summit agenda
world.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Chinese President Xi Jinping, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and other world leaders are gathering in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, for the 26th Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit. This two-day event marks the bloc's 25th anniversary, focusing on key issues such as security, trade, and regional conflicts among member states and partners.

world.title: PM Modi likely to hold bilateral talks with Iranian president
world.summary: PM Narendra Modi is expected to hold a bilateral meeting with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian during the SCO summit in Kyrgyzstan on Monday. This meeting would mark their first discussion since the outbreak of the war in the Middle East. The talks aim to strengthen ties between India and Iran amid ongoing regional developments and geopolitical challenges.

business.title: India’s mobile output is up 33X: Rs 62,500 Cr PLI 2.0 opens a new chapter for 2 stocks
business.summary: India's mobile manufacturing sector is experiencing significant growth, with output increasing 33 times. The government's new Mobile Phone Manufacturing Scheme, or PLI 2.0, aims to enhance this growth by focusing on capturing a larger share of the value chain, rather than solely increasing phone production. The scheme has an investment outlay of ₹62,500 crore to support this initiative.

business.title: Record Dates This Week: India Glycols demerger, Multiple PSU stocks trade ex
business.summary: Multiple state-run companies, including Coal India and ONGC, will trade ex-dividend this week, alongside various corporate actions from other firms. Additionally, India Glycols will trade ex-dividend due to the demerger of its multiple entities. A complete list of corporate actions scheduled for this week has been provided, highlighting significant financial events in the market.

business.title: Stocks to Watch Today: HDFC Bank, Avantel, Cipla, Max Estates, Clean Max, Axiscades, Aurobindo Pharma, NBCC, Augmont Enterprises in focus on 31 August
business.summary: On August 31, 2026, several stocks will be in focus, including HDFC Bank, Cipla, Axiscades Technologies, Max Estates, Avantel, Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions, Aurobindo Pharma, Genus Power Infrastructures, Religare Enterprises, and Augmont Enterprises. Investors are advised to monitor these companies for potential market movements and developments.

technology.title: Gamescom 2026 draws 368,000 visitors from 131 countries
technology.summary: Gamescom 2026 attracted 368,000 visitors from 131 countries, marking a 6% increase from the previous year's attendance of 357,000. While it did not set a new record, the event showcased a more international presence than ever before. The growth reflects a continuing interest in gaming events, despite falling short of the previous peak attendance figures.

technology.title: Fable's Main Quest Will Take About 20 Hours to Beat
technology.summary: Fable's main quest is estimated to take approximately 20 hours to complete, according to Playground Games. In addition to the main storyline, players can expect around 15-20 hours of side quests and open-world exploration. The game features limitless life systems, allowing players to engage in various activities beyond the main quest, extending gameplay significantly if desired.

technology.title: Microsoft breaks mouse cursors in Windows 11 with a new update, per reports
technology.summary: Microsoft's recent KB5120998 update for Windows 11 has reportedly caused mouse cursor functionality issues for users. This essential feature is malfunctioning, impacting the ability to operate PCs effectively. The company has acknowledged the problem after receiving numerous complaints from users. Microsoft is expected to address the issue in a future update to restore normal cursor functionality.

sports.title: 'Part of the problem' - Michael Carrick told he must urgently replace Man Utd star after dismal display
sports.summary: Manchester United manager Michael Carrick has been advised to urgently replace a struggling defender following a poor performance in a 5-2 victory against Ipswich Town. Despite the win, pundits criticized the team's defensive weaknesses, highlighting that the defender was "part of the problem." The match saw United concede an early goal from Leif Davis, raising concerns about their defense.

sports.title: Lamine Yamal getting back to ‘top level’, Barcelona coach Flick says
sports.summary: Barcelona coach Hansi Flick stated that Lamine Yamal is regaining his "top level" ahead of the upcoming La Liga match against Rayo Vallecano. The 19-year-old faced challenges during the season opener against Elche but showed improvement in his performance against Athletic Bilbao. Flick's comments highlight the coach's optimism regarding Yamal's development and contributions to the team.

sports.title: Revanth Plans Cricket Stadium In Future City
sports.summary: The BCCI plans to construct a world-class cricket stadium in Bharat Future City, Hyderabad, covering 100 acres. The stadium aims to match the seating capacity of the 1.32-lakh seater Narendra Modi Stadium in Gujarat. Chief Minister A. Revanth has initiated the project, with the BCCI responsible for both construction and operational costs. Preparations are currently underway.

health.title: Diabetes impacts men, women differently: Study
health.summary: A study reveals that type 2 diabetes complications vary by gender. Men are more susceptible to heart and kidney diseases, while women face a higher risk of developing mental health issues. This research highlights the need for gender-specific approaches in managing diabetes and its associated complications, emphasizing the distinct health challenges posed by the condition for both men and women.

health.title: Andhra Pradesh: Healthy Habits Key To Good Health: Dr Manthena
health.summary: Naturopathy expert Dr. Manthena Satyanarayana Raju emphasized the importance of healthy living in Tirupati. He identified poor food habits, insufficient physical activity, and lack of rest as major contributors to health issues. Dr. Raju advocated for a return to natural living, highlighting that proper nutrition, adequate rest, and regular exercise are essential for maintaining overall good health.

health.title: How to Protect Memory After Poor Sleep, According to New Study
health.summary: A recent study indicates that exercise and a 90-minute nap can help protect memory after 30 hours of sleep deprivation. Sleep deficiency is associated with various chronic health issues. The findings suggest that incorporating physical activity and short naps may mitigate some cognitive impairments caused by lack of sleep, highlighting the importance of maintaining memory health.

science.title: NASA Inaugurates Deep Space Station 23
science.summary: NASA has officially inaugurated Deep Space Station 23, part of its Deep Space Network. The event featured a ribbon-cutting ceremony attended by leadership from NASA Headquarters and the Jet Propulsion Laboratory. This facility will enhance communication with spacecraft exploring distant celestial bodies, supporting ongoing and future missions. Deep Space Station 23 represents a significant advancement in space exploration capabilities.

science.title: Roman Telescope Begins Quest to Reveal Evolving Universe
science.summary: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope was launched today, marking the beginning of a new era in space exploration. This telescope aims to enhance our understanding of the evolving universe by observing distant galaxies and cosmic phenomena. It is expected to provide valuable data that could reshape current scientific knowledge and contribute significantly to various fields of astrophysics.

science.title: A Chicago physicist proposed a way to create quantum images 20 years ago; after two decades waiting for experimental proof, superconductors have finally produced the effect he predicted
science.summary: Dirk Morr, a physicist at the University of Illinois Chicago, proposed a quantum imaging technique using superconductors 20 years ago. Recent experiments have finally demonstrated the effect he predicted, confirming his theoretical work. This advancement in quantum imaging could enhance our understanding of electron behavior and lead to new applications in various fields, including materials science and technology.

A sense of hope and renewal is on the horizon, suggesting that brighter days are approaching after the darkness.

entertainment.summary: Pisces individuals are encouraged to free themselves from current struggles and chaos. Recognizing this perspective may empower Pisces to choose their path forward, emphasizing personal growth and resilience.
